notes.title: [2021/11/15]Patch Ver1.0.4 Release
notes.content:
Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate received an update for Patch Ver1.0.4 on 11/15 at 9:00pm PST.
Please update the game to continue playing.

[b][Ver1.0.4 Patch Notes][/b]
[list][*]Issue wherein stepping on particular spots in certain dungeons would cause an error has been fixed. 
[*]Issue wherein an error would occur under certain conditions in "Rousing Paradise" has been fixed.
[*]Various stability improvements.
[/list]

[b][Reporting Issues][/b]
If you experience issues with the latest version, please e-mail our support team:

support-shiren@spike-chunsoft.co.jp

notes.title: [2020/12/22]Patch Ver1.0.2 Release
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who participated in the Open Beta!
We have finished testing and have implemented these fixes on the default game build. 
*Open Beta branch is now closed.

[b][Ver1.0.2 Patch Notes][/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue where application would crash after reconnecting USB/wireless controller. (*1/*2)
[*]Error message now displays if application fails to start from launcher.
[*]Fixed frame rate issues.
[*]Added launcher menu option to reverse game pad inputs for X / Y | △ / □. [/list]

*1:Please disable external game pad drivers/applications as these may conflict with game settings.
*2:If you would like to continue using your current game pad configuration, check the option from the Launcher Menu: “Other”

[b][Reporting Issues][/b]
If you experience issues with the latest version, please e-mail our support team:

support-shiren@spike-chunsoft.co.jp

notes.title: [2020/12/15]Beta Branch Available
notes.content:
[b][Open Beta Test][/b]
We have a patch on the way to address game pad issues.
Since these issues can be user-specific, we will run an Open Beta before applying the settings to the default build.
Once we have worked out possible issues, we will apply the Beta fixes to the default build.

[b][Beta Build Revisions][/b][list][*]Fixed issue where application would crash after reconnecting USB/wireless controller. (*1/*2)
[*]Error message now displays if application fails to start from launcher.
[*]Fixed frame rate issues.
[*]Added launcher menu option to reverse game pad inputs for X / Y  | △ / □. [/list]
*1:Please disable external game pad drivers/applications as these may conflict with game settings.
*2:If you would like to continue using your current game pad configuration, check the option from the Launcher Menu: “Other”

[b][Accessing the Beta][/b]
1) Steam Library > Right click “Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate”
2) Click “Properties” > Select “BETAS”
3) Enter the password “102betaversion”, then click “Check Code”
4) Select the branch “102betaversion”
5) Restart Steam if the update does not start automatically. 
6)  Launch the application. The Launcher Menu should display the version number “ver1.0.2) in the upper-right corner

[b][Reporting Issues][/b]
If you experience issues with the Beta, please e-mail our support team:

support-shiren@spike-chunsoft.co.jp

notes.title: [2020/12/7]PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Today's patch fixes the following issues:
*Fixed issue where game would sometimes freeze when BGM changed when moving between locations.
*Fixed issue where Spring Trap placement could make it impossible to clear a floor in certain dungeons. 
*Fixed text overflow issues.
